title: Wren and the Homecoming
author: Xanthe Crane
blurb: Casper Blackwood, a scholarship student at an academy with too many secrets, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. But when the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship before prom.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
